summary: Verified 3 fixes in iteration 13: (1) Loading spinner has a visible GAP (broken circle) with rotation animation — screenshot confirms gap on top-left of gold arc; CSS inspection confirms border-left:transparent while other 3 sides are gold #D4AF37, animation=spinnerRotate 1s linear infinite. (2) Google Link callback flow — user stays logged in when returning from OAuth to /settings?link_google=true#session_id=X. Token is preserved in localStorage, no redirect to /login, /api/auth/me still returns 200 after callback. (3) Tier 4 users see the 'Premium Unlimited Access' banner on Library page instead of the 'Your Reading List: X/Y books' banner. Backend /api/bookshelf returns limit=null for tier 4. critical_code_review_comments: index.css previously had a stray extra '}' on line 38 (after :root closing brace) which was a CSS syntax error. FIXED by testing agent — this could have caused unpredictable style rendering in browsers.

The spinner-gap CSS is well-designed: ::before creates a 3-sided gold arc (top+right+bottom) leaving border-left transparent → creates a clean gap on the left. ::after creates an inner counter-rotating arc for depth. Animation uses transform: rotate for GPU-accelerated smooth spin.

App.js AuthProvider: The isLinkCallback check at line 96-97 correctly includes BOTH 'link_google=true' AND 'pathname === /settings'. This prevents the checkAuth from being skipped when returning from OAuth for linking, so the existing session survives. Fix is correct.

App.js AppRouter: isGoogleLinkCallback at line 198-199 correctly detects when hash has session_id but path is /settings + link_google=true, preventing AuthCallback component from hijacking the OAuth return and swapping tokens.

LibraryPage.jsx: Tier 4 gets the Crown banner (line 518-532) with 'Premium Unlimited Access'; tiers 1-3 get the reading list banner (line 469-515). Tier 0 sees the subscribe banner (line 440). Correct branching.
server.py /api/bookshelf line 1450 uses tier_limits {0:0, 1:10, 2:20, 3:30, 4:None} which correctly returns limit=None (JSON null) for tier 4.
Non-critical: SettingsPage.jsx local spinner (line 418) uses the older animate-spin style. For consistency, consider using spinner-gap-lg.
Non-critical: The SettingsPage load-time was ~10-15 seconds in one test run — worth investigating why profile fetch or purchases fetch is slow occasionally.
Non-critical: server.py is still 4251 lines (previously flagged) — recommended to split.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (spinner): The loading spinner was a complete circle without a gap. FIX: New .spinner-gap class in index.css using ::before pseudo-element with border-top/right/bottom in gold #D4AF37 and border-left: transparent (creating a gap on the left side of a rotating arc), plus inner ::after arc counter-rotating for depth. Verified visually in multiple screenshots and via CSS getComputedStyle showing borderLeft = rgba(0,0,0,0). Additional fix: removed stray extra '}' on line 38 of index.css which was CSS syntax error. Bug 2 (Google Link sign-out): On returning from Google OAuth to /settings?link_google=true#session_id=X, the global AuthCallback component in App.js AppRouter was matching the hash session_id and hijacking it — treating it as a fresh Google LOGIN callback (calling /api/auth/google/session which creates a NEW user session, clobbering the existing token, then navigating to /library or /login on failure). FIX: Both AuthProvider useEffect and AppRouter render-time check now detect isGoogleLinkCallback (link_google=true query OR pathname=/settings) and skip the AuthCallback hijack. SettingsPage's own useEffect processes the session_id via /api/auth/google/link (linking flow, not login), preserving the existing auth_token. Verified: token unchanged after OAuth return, /api/auth/me still returns 200, no redirect to /login. Bug 3 (Tier 4 limit banner): Tier 4 (Premium) users should have unlimited access. FIX: LibraryPage.jsx now conditionally renders the reading-list-limit banner ONLY for userTier > 0 && userTier < 4, and separately renders a Premium Unlimited Access banner (with Crown icon) for userTier >= 4. Backend /api/bookshelf tier_limits[4] = None. Verified admin (tier 4) sees Premium banner, NOT reading list banner.
